related_questions.question: Can I get a copy of my immunization records online in Arkansas?

text_blocks.snippet: Yes, you can request a copy of your immunization records online in Arkansas through the Arkansas Department of Health's website. You'll need to fill out a shot record request form, which can be found on the Immunizations page. You may also be able to access your records through the MyIR Mobile app, if your vaccination information is in the Arkansas Immunization Information System (WebIZ).
snippet_highlighted_words: Yes, you can request a copy of your immunization records online in Arkansas through the Arkansas Department of Health's website

text_blocks.snippet: Here's how to get your records:

list.title: 1. Locate the Shot Record Request Form:
list.snippet: Go to the Arkansas Department of Health's Immunizations page. Look for the "shot record request form" or a similar link to initiate the request.

list.title: 2. Complete the Form:
list.snippet: Provide all the necessary information, including your name, date of birth, and contact information. You'll also need to indicate where to send the official immunization record.

list.title: 3. Provide Identification:
list.snippet: A copy of a valid, government-issued photo ID is required for phone, fax, mail, or email requests.

list.title: 4. Submit Your Request:
list.snippet: Follow the instructions on the form to submit your request.

list.title: 5. Check MyIR Mobile:
list.snippet: If you are in a state participating in MyIR Mobile, you can also check if your records are accessible through the app.

text_blocks.snippet: If you have trouble finding your records or need assistance, you can also contact the Arkansas Department of Health or your healthcare provider.
